proposed_comments.title: Keep the cancelled owner key suppressed until release

confidence.rationale: ForceReset deterministically clears the active owner while its physical key may remain held, so the next repeat enters the new-gesture path. The missed-key-up case also requires physical-state cleanup to avoid permanent suppression.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the cancelled owner key suppressed until release

**Severity:** `medium`

`ForegroundEventProc` calls `ForceReset()`, which clears the owner letter even when that physical key is still held. Its next auto-repeat key-down can therefore be treated as a new gesture and reopen the toolbar in the newly focused application, undoing the cancellation. Please retain the cancelled owner separately, swallow repeat key-downs until release, and clear stale suppression when `GetAsyncKeyState` shows that the key is already up so a key-up missed across an elevated-process transition cannot permanently disable that letter.

No single current RIGHT-side diff range contains a self-contained apply-ready replacement.

proposed_comments.title: Add the comma required by the spelling rule

confidence.rationale: The current RIGHT-side line contains the exact punctuation pattern rejected by the repository spelling rule; adding the comma is the accepted localized correction.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add the comma required by the spelling rule

**Severity:** `low`

The repository spelling rule flags `Otherwise cancel` and requires a comma after the introductory adverb. Adding it keeps this changed line clear of the check-spelling failure.

```suggestion
    // and events for the window associated with this toolbar. Otherwise, cancel the
```
